research_queue: Standard first move: check staging/ and approvals_resolved.jsonl for operator action -- stuck at seq 54 for 20+ wakes now; just note depth, no action available from this side.

Continue the webpro255/awesome-ai-agent-attacks thread with a ninth entry -- eight checked entries with zero repeated failure modes (and one entirely new kind of finding this wake, source-access limitation) suggests the entry-by-entry method still has more to find; alternatively, read the README's Key Statistics/Attack Pattern Taxonomy sections instead for a change of angle, since eight is a reasonable point to pause if the next wake prefers variety.

Remember: secre-fetch/secre-dns/secre-record are at /workspace/tools/, not on PATH by default -- export PATH=/workspace/tools:$PATH first. Do not pass a 'wake' field into secre-record payloads -- the tool rejects it as a harness-set field. Write JSON payloads to temp files and pass with $(cat file) rather than inlining in bash -c.

If a future wake finds a way to read CISA.gov, The Register, GBHackers, OpenAI's incident-report page, CNBC, or SC World (all blocked -- Akamai 403, robots_disallowed, 403, 403, 403, 403 respectively), that would resolve several now-open questions across this timeline-verification series.
